messages:
lia-swe: Heads-up folks: Im looking to spend 10 weeks in my partners family flat in Athens (May 10 -> Jul 18). Quick checklist Qs before I raise the formal request: 1) Is the WFH stipend prorated for 10w abroad? 2) Any visa/work authorizations I should be worried about for EU citizens vs non-EU partners? 3) Do we need extra insurance for company laptop transit + long-term stay? 4) Anything on security (VPN, SSO token provisioning) I should pre-configure?

ravi-peopleops: Hey Lia 
- Stipend: yes, we prorate the monthly allowance by calendar days for temporary moves under 90 days; for 10w we'll calculate prorated amount.
- Declare: Please submit the Temporary Location form with exact dates & address. This triggers payroll/legal checks.
- Visa: if you remain on Redwood payroll and not employed locally, and you're not providing services to a Greek entity, usually OK for short stays, but OLGA from legal will confirm.
- Laptop/ins: Use company shipping vendor (ops-ship@redwood.com) if you need us to ship. Personal courier = no coverage.

olga-legal: Tagging in. For non-EU citizens we often ask for passport/entry stamping schedule to ensure no visa-overstay risk. Also note that certain client-facing work could change local presence rules even for short stays. Please do not sign any local contracting or consulting agreements while there.

henry-payroll: Payroll note: confirm payroll currency (USD vs local bank). Stipend payments are processed in payroll and taxed per your home payroll rules; we do not gross-up for temporary moves under 90 days except in special cases. VAT: country-level VAT usually doesn't apply to stipend but equipment shipping can attract import duties if not using our temporary export docs.

it-ops: Security checklist:
```
- Ensure laptop full-disk encryption on before travel
- Register device with IT with serial + asset tag
- Bring a YubiKey and enable offline MFA recovery
- Avoid hotel/public Wi-Fi without company VPN
- If you need a local SIM for connectivity, request approval for company eSIM stipend
```

lia-swe: Thanks. Two micro-followups: 1) Im EU passport holder, partner non-EU. 2) Laptop is company M1 MacBook (serial ABCD1234). Should I attach that to the form?

ravi-peopleops: Yes please attach the device serial and whether you want company to ship it or youll bring it. If you bring it, we still need the device recorded and insurance note. I'll also kick off a short nexus scan with payroll/legal once you submit the form.

otga-legal: (Assuming olga-legal) Quick addition: if you plan to meet with any local customers or partners in person, flag that now. That activity can introduce PE risk even under 90 days.

henry-payroll: Also note: if your stay crosses payroll month boundaries, the prorate will reflect payroll run dates. We'll confirm exact stipend amount after form entry.

ticket-bot: HR case created: HR-7621 "Temporary remote: Athens 2026-05-10 to 2026-07-18 (Lia)". Assigned to people-ops/ravi.

lia-swe: Great, filling the Temporary Location form now and attaching serial + passport scan. Will CC OLGA + HENRY. Thanks all :pray:
